23275763.name: Ro07-3953

23664627.name: Potassium salicylate
23664627.description: Potassium salicylate is the potassium salt of salicylic acid. It exists as the monohydrate KC7H5O3·H2O below 29 °C , where it decomposes to the anhydrous form .

23669619.name: Potassium 2-ethylhexanoate

25030387.name: CR665

44719475.name: Aleph-6

49799795.name: Neurolenin B

49831411.name: Aripiprazole lauroxil

50902259.name: Sepetaprost
50902259.description: Sepetaprost is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated for the treatment of open angle glaucoma and ocular hypertension.

53682035.name: Α,α-Dideuterophenethylamine
53682035.description: α,α-Dideuterophenethylamine, also known as PE-α,α-d2 or D2PE, is a deuterated isotopologue of phenethylamine.

54393203.name: 18-Methyltestosterone
54393203.description: 18-Methyltestosterone is an androgen/anabolic steroid which was never marketed.

54670067.name: Redoxon
54670067.description: Redoxon is the brand name of the first artificially synthesized ascorbic acid .

57363059.name: Β-Methyl-DOM
57363059.description: β-Methyl-DOM, or β-Me-DOM, also known as 4-methyl-2,5-dimethoxy-β-methylamphetamine, is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and DOx families related to DOM.

64565107.name: Trifluoroproscaline
64565107.description: Trifluoroproscaline , also known as 4- -3,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to mescaline.

67333747.name: Dimethandrolone undecanoate

71602803.name: Voxelotor

87410419.name: Cyclopentadienyl magnesium bromide

91997555.name: Methyl violet 2B

118548467.name: SAGE-324
118548467.description: SAGE-324, also known as BIIB124, is an experimental drug.

122582003.name: KRM-II-81
122582003.description: KRM-II-81 is a positive allosteric modulator of the GABAA receptor.

124389619.name: AP-238
124389619.description: AP-238 is an opioid designer drug related to drugs such as azaprocin and bucinnazine, with around the same potency as morphine.

135398643.name: Inosine triphosphate
135398643.description: Inosine triphosphate is an intermediate in the purine metabolism pathway, seen in the synthesis of ATP and GTP.

135462899.name: Eupenifeldin
135462899.description: Eupenifeldin is a cytotoxic bistropolone isolate of Eupenicillium brefeldianum.

156137203.name: 4-HO-EiPT
156137203.description: 4-HO-EiPT, also known as 4-hydroxy-N-ethyl-N-isopropyltryptamine, is a little-known chemical compound of the tryptamine and 4-hydroxytryptamine families.

170327283.name: JGB-1-155
170327283.description: JGB-1-155, is a drug which acts as a selective positive allosteric modulator of the enzyme nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase .

170703347.name: 1D-LSD
170703347.description: 1D-LSD, also known as 1- -LSD or as SYN-L-229, is a psychedelic drug of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide .

177841651.name: Cyaarside
177841651.description: Cyaarside, also called cyarside, is the −C≡As anion. Featuring a triple bond between arsenic and carbon, it is the arsenic analogue of cyanide and cyaphide.

900000115.name: Afelimomab

900000371.name: Caesium enneabromodibismuthate
900000371.description: Caesium enneabromodibismuthate is an inorganic compound with the formula Cs3Bi2Br9.

900000499.name: Concizumab

900000627.name: Disodium cocoamphodiacetate

900000755.name: Estradiol cypionate/testosterone enanthate

900001011.name: Indusatumab vedotin

900001139.name: Libivirumab

900001395.name: ORG-47241

900001523.name: Pernitride

900001651.name: Polymethylpentene
900001651.description: Polymethylpentene , also known as poly . It is used for gas-permeable packaging, autoclavable medical and laboratory equipment, microwave components, and cookware.

900001779.name: Relfovetmab

900001907.name: Sodium tetracarbonylcobaltate

900002035.name: Thorium heptaphosphide
900002035.description: Thorium heptaphosphide is a binary inorganic compound of thorium metal and phosphorus with the chemical formula ThP7. This is the most phosphorus-rich binary compound of a tetravalent thorium.
